Alle sportlichen steigen die Stiegen, aber es gibt auch einen Lift direkt von der U6 Station Burggasse-Stadthalle. Seit Donnerstag, 01.10.2026 gibt es eine neue Karte. Aber ein paar „Signature Dishes“, wie das Mushroom Ka Prao. Die Pumpkin Fritters von den „Nibblers“ waren eine super Empfehlung. Die Soße ist aber scharf, also gut machbar, wenn man die weglässt. Die Sticky Rice Dumplings sind wirklich gut und mit Pilzen gefüllt, aber das Chiliöl wirklich scharf. Vienna × Amsterdam 🇦🇹🇳🇱 restaurant_herzig florisvstraalen vanoostrestaurant One Michelin-starred kitchen. Two chefs. One unforgettable four-hands dinner. For one special evening at Herzig, Sören Herzig welcomed Floris van Straalen of VanOost Amsterdam for a menu that brought two distinct culinary worlds together. From Balfegó akamé with mikan, nori & bergamot, to eel with herbs & horseradish, Indonesian langoustine with sambal & bumbu, black hake with crispy salad, ’nduja & Sauternes, sweetbread with yuzu, truffle & artichoke, and finally pigeon with beetroot, fig leaf & pistachio ajo verde. A beautiful dialogue between Vienna and Amsterdam — playful, precise and full of character. #vien

We went to Vienna looking for its most famous schnitzel. Instead, we abandoned the queue and found our best one by accident. Our original plan was Figlmüller, where I had eaten years earlier. But the original location wasn’t accepting guests without a reservation—and its second restaurant had another long line outside. Across the street, Kussmaul was almost empty. Leaving Vienna’s most famous schnitzel queue for a quiet restaurant didn’t feel like the obvious decision. But the meat was incredibly tender, the coating was wonderfully crunchy, and it became our best Wienerschnitzel experience up to that point.
